name: 33127 · Miami, FL
findings: ZIP 33127 (Miami) has 146 nonprofit organizations. 39 of them (27%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33127 (Miami) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
74% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 33127 (Miami) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 77% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 13 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
